title: Hong Kong on-ramp: g6y reservation bundles & launch playbook
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: Launch a Hong Kong (ap-east-3) dedicated capacity offering with the new g6y instance family and two reservation bundles (standard and burst-balance). This ticket coordinates cross-functional GTM work: pricing SKU mapping, billing test cases, Console + Marketplace listing, partner enablement, compliance sign-off, observability dashboards, and launch communications.

Scope:
- Add g6y SKU to catalog for ap-east-3 with pricing parity model tiering (g6y.small, g6y.medium, g6y.large).
- Introduce reservation bundles: "Reserve-12m-Standard" and "Reserve-12m-BurstBalance" with commit and burst allowances.
- Console UX updates: region selector, SKU labels, reservation purchase flow, and rollout flags.
- Billing: price propagation, invoice line items, marketplace SKU mapping, and tax region checks.
- Docs and release notes: public release notes + internal enablement playbook.
- Telemetry: latency/cost dashboards, per-tenant reservation utilization metrics, and SLA monitors.
- Runbooks: rollback, capacity downgrade, and graceful fallback to hosted models.

Out of scope: on-prem package changes and changes to runtime kernel selection (handled by ENG separately).

Acceptance criteria (must be met before greenlight):
1) Console rollout flag enabled in staging and in a targeted beta org list.
2) Billing integration tests passing in sandbox and sample invoices show new SKU lines.
3) Marketplace listing approved and published (if partner pathway used).
4) Observability dashboards show g6y baselines and automated alerts configured for 99th percentile latency regressions.
5) Legal/compliance sign-off completed for Hong Kong (data residency and KMS key usage).
6) Playbook published to internal Confluence with step-by-step rollback and migration steps.

Launch timeline (high level):
- 2026-02-10: Kickoff (this ticket created).
- 2026-02-22: Billing and SKU design complete.
- 2026-03-05: Console feature gated deployment to staging + beta orgs.
- 2026-03-12: Billing sandbox validation and marketplace submission.
- 2026-03-15: Legal/compliance sign-off target.
- 2026-03-18: Telemetry and runbook finalization.
- 2026-03-20: Gradual soft launch to pilot customers.
